Pick your driver and car, then beat eight rivals one at a time to the free fuel and charging station. Beat Brian and the final boss, Dominic Toretto, to become champion.

Hold → or D to drive, ← or A to brake, ↑ ↓ to change lane, Space to boost, N for nitro (Brian and Dom only), P to pause.
Electric cars grab lightning bolts. Petrol cars grab jerry cans.

Tap Full screen (top left) for the best view.
